blind107: Count physical cash before reviewing receipts. The expected balance stays hidden at this step.
keyboard107: Enter quantities or use + and −. Enter moves to the next denomination; arrow keys adjust one unit.
clearConfirm107: Clear every quantity in this count?
changed107: The count changed. Return to editing and review it again.
zero107: The counted total is zero. Confirm only if this drawer holds no physical cash.
zeroAck107: I checked the drawer and confirm it holds no physical cash.
ack107: I checked the notes and coins and confirm the counted total.
local107: This step saves the count for review. The drawer is closed after payment review.
invalidCount107: Enter valid whole quantities of notes and coins.
saveFailed107: The count could not be saved. Values were kept; check the warning before retrying.
